result.summary: A resend of the 09:20 transfer at version 3 would pass the version check and move the patient from WARD-C back to WARD-B, a ward they left at 09:45: the bed board, pharmacy and porters would act on the wrong ward (DEP-2.2). Sending nothing leaves the record in WARD-C, which matches the latest applied movement.
